item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We are clear about the stakes: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We work for a ban because preventing human extinction is not optional.

2. We cannot afford to treat superintelligence as another product launch. Built with anything like current techniques, it will kill everyone on Earth. We need a ban—not a race to build it first.

3. We want humanity to have a future. That means stopping superintelligence before anyone builds it. With anything like current techniques, the outcome will be human extinction. We are working to prevent it.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 108 words

We hold a clear position: if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. That is why we work for a ban on superintelligence. We are not asking which company should win the race, or which country should get there first. We are asking how we stop a race whose finish line is human extinction. Our task is to turn that imperative into public understanding and enforceable policy. We want a future in which people can live, build, discover, and flourish. To protect that future, we must prevent superintelligence from being built. That is the purpose guiding our work and this newsletter.
